chunks: And from him, from Aḥmad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Saʿdān, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) said: "Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will turn on the Day of Resurrection toward the poor among the believers, as one resembling an apologizer to them, and He will say: ‘By My might and My majesty, I did not make you poor in the world because of any humiliation of you before Me; and you shall surely see what I will do for you today. So whoever gave any one of you some kindness in the abode of the world, then take him by the hand and admit him into Paradise.’"

He said: Then a man among them will say: ‘O my Lord, the people of the world competed regarding their worldly life: they married women, wore soft garments, ate food, lived in houses, and rode well-known mounts, so give me the like of what You gave them.’ Then He, Blessed and Exalted, will say: ‘For you, and for every servant among you, is the like of what I gave the people of the world from the time the world began until the world came to an end, multiplied seventy times.’

key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the final abode of reward
key_terms.تَنَافَسُوا: they competed with one another in worldly enjoyments
key_terms.دَارِ الدُّنْيَا: the abode of worldly life, contrasted with the Hereafter
key_terms.سَبْعِينَ ضِعْفًا: seventyfold, indicating a vastly multiplied reward
key_terms.فُقَرَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the poor believers who are singled out for divine regard on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.مَعْرُوفًا: an act of kindness or beneficence done for someone
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, when recompense and divine judgment are manifested

ai.seo_question: How does Allah reward poor believers on the Day of Resurrection according to Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes Allah’s special regard for the poor believers on the Day of Resurrection and His declaration that their poverty was not due to any humiliation before Him. It also shows the immense recompense awaiting them in the Hereafter and honors those who showed them kindness in worldly life.

en.hubeali: And from him, from Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sa’dan who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Allahazwj would be Turning (with Mercy) towards the poor Momineen on the Day of Judgement aimilar to being Apologetic towards them and Heazwj would be Saying: “ By Myazwj Honour and Myazwj Majestic! Iazwj did not Impoverish you all in the world due to abasement with you upon Meazwj, and you will be seeing what Iazwj shall be Doing with you today.So the one who provided any one of you in the house of the world with goodness, so grab him by the hand and enter him into the Paradise”.

He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So a man from them would be saying, ‘O Lord<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! The people of the world used to compete with each other in regarding their world, so they married the women and wore the soft clothes, and ate the meals, and dwelled in the houses, and rode the distinguished from the riding animals, therefore Give me similar to what You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Given them’. So the Blessed and High would be Saying: “For you and for every servant from you all would be similar to what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Given, seventy times over, to the people of the world (in the Paradise) since that World exist (forever) after the expiry of the (moral) world’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sa’dan who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘On the Day of Judgment Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, will turn to the poor believing people, similar to an apologetic one, and will say, “I swear by My Majesty and Glory that I did not make you suffer poverty in the world, considering you insignificant. You will find out how I treat you today. Hold the hands of those who helped you in the worldly life and take them to paradise.”

The narrator has said that the Imam then said, ‘A man from among them will say, ‘O Lord, people competed in their world to marry, dress up in fine garments, to have fine food, nice houses, and riding best animals, thus, give me what you had given to them.’ Allah, the Most Blessed, the Most High, will say, ‘You and every one of you will have what I had given to the people of the world from its beginning to its end, seventy times as much.’”
